The studio

About PinkRyno Studios

PinkRyno Studios is a tiny independent studio in Florida. We make games for children ages 3 to 6: short, colorful, and calm enough to hand over.

Bubbles, our pink rhinoceros, is the studio mascot. Bubbles is here to wave, not to collect anything.

What we hold to

  • A child should be able to start playing without an account, a sign-up form, or a wall of words.
  • The way off this website is for grown-ups. App stores and email sit behind a parental gate.
  • If a game has more to open, it is a one-time unlock. No subscription, no surprise cart, and no button that sends a child to download other apps.
  • Gentle on purpose. Soft colors, a path a child can trace at their own pace, and no ads along the way.

Tiny Trails is our series of tracing games. Tiny Trails: Space is the first: cosmic worlds, a glowing trail, and a star at the end.
